_comment: Delta-neutral funding carry: long spot + short perp on the best pair, held for weeks. Rules in CLAUDE.md.

capital_management._comment_fraction: Fraction of the rebalanced USDT deployed per position (keeps a buffer for fees and price moves)

funding_rate_strategy._comment_apr: Enter only when the funding APR averaged over funding_avg_days is >= this. A round trip costs ~0.4% of notional (4 taker legs at 0.1%, conservative until real fills are measured); paying that back over a ~30-day hold with a 2x margin needs 2 x 0.4% x 365/30 = ~10% APR.

position_management._comment_rotation: After min_hold_days, rotate only if another pair's averaged APR beats the held one by this many APR points (same ~10 point arithmetic as above). A held pair whose averaged APR drops to -min_funding_apr is closed at any age.
position_management._comment_interval: Seconds between cycles. The stop-loss is checked every cycle, so keep this short.

leverage_settings._comment_leverage: Perp leverage 1-3. 1 = 50/50 spot/perp, 2 = 67/33, 3 = 75/25. Stop-loss is automatic on perp PnL as % of perp notional, 70% of the way to liquidation: 1x -69%, 2x -34%, 3x -22%.
